verdict.rationale: Most of the MCP evidence (remote and local connectors, the custom-connector article cited by the probe) shows Claude acting as an MCP client, which cannot be credited here. However, the platform's llms.txt documents a first-party hosted MCP endpoint at platform.claude.com/docs/mcp that external MCP clients can connect to. That server only searches and reads documentation. Missing for 10: an official MCP server exposing Claude's own capabilities (chats, projects, API actions) to other agents, setup/auth documentation for that server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect an MCP client to https://platform.claude.com/docs/mcp (Streamable HTTP transport) to search and read these docs
